title: Local paranormal investigators offering 8+ fall events
excerpt: This organization is known for its investigations and large-scale celebrations, but even with a full fall slate ahead, its efforts remain local.
content:
TWO VIRGINIAS (WVVA) - The spooky season is upon us, and with that comes all things creepy…crawly…and ghoulish.

Hoping to help you navigate the spiritual world is Coal Country Paranormal.

This season, Coal Country Paranormal (formerly Appalachian Ghost Tours) is working to increase tourism in the Two Virginias by bridging the seen and unseen of the past.

“One thing we all have in common is the desire to preserve that history for future generations along with the fascination with the paranormal, and honestly the two go hand-in-hand. Without the history, you wouldn’t have these spirits that linger, you know, to have their stories told,” said Coal Country Paranormal team member Pamela Huff.

“A lot of times when we’re looking at trying to find a new location, we’re trying to find one that’s either got some historic connection to it or might need some help with additional funding,” added team member James Ratliff.

This organization is known for its investigations and large-scale celebrations, but even with a full fall slate ahead, its efforts remain local.

“Honestly, our heart is here, our roots are here…the majority of the team is from Southern West Virginia or Southwest Virginia,” Huff continued.

With upcoming festivals, investigations, tours and more, be prepared for a wild, but possibly quiet ride that Ratliff said will perhaps leave you with more questions than answers.

“It’s not like we’re ghost adventurers, we’re not going to make everybody scream all the time, that’s not the point. The point kind of is to show that it’s kind of a sitting and waiting game,” Ratliff added.

“You’re not just going to show up and automatically get a response or something like that, but I will say that we do have a lot of people that come back.”

Head to this website for tickets, and for more information on upcoming events.

Some upcoming Coal County Paranormal events:

September 18, 19: Campbell-Flannagan-Murrell House Museum ghost tours (8 p.m. – 12 a.m.)

September 26: Mountain Lake Lodge paranormal investigation (6 p.m. – 12 a.m.)

October 3: Litz Mansion Haunt Fest (12 p.m. – 6 p.m.)

October 9: Campbell-Flannagan-Murrell House Museum ghost tour (8 p.m. – 12 a.m.)

October 10: Campbell-Flannagan-Murrell House Museum overnight investigation (8 p.m. – 6 a.m.)

October 17: Price Mansion paranormal investigation (6:30 p.m. – 11 p.m.)

October 24: Mountain Lake Lodge Paranormal Prom (7 p.m. – 11 p.m.)
